title.narrative: Project to support the sustainable development of aquaculture in Côte d'Ivoire

description.narrative: AD-CI's theory of change projects a catalytic repositioning of aquaculture within the fisheries sector to sustainably improve production capacity and meet national demand, increasing its contribution from the current less than 10% to at least 35% of national fish production by end of the project. PAD-CI¿s development aim is to increase the performance and resilience of aquaculture production systems for food and nutrition security, and entrepreneurship, particularly for youth and women. Impact will be measured by an increase in national production from the current approximate 10,000 tons to 30,000 tons, and by the creation of 15,000 new jobs. Two outcomes are expected: (i) the productivity and total output of aquaculture production systems improved; and (ii) the value added by aquaculture increased.The Aquaculture Project for Youth Employment Development (APYED)/Projet Aquacole pour le Developpement de l'Emploi des Jeunes (PADEJ) aims to unlock Côte d'Ivoire's aquaculture sector's potential to boost food security, create jobs, and improve rural livelihoods. The sector faces critical challenges, such as limited access to quality inputs (fingerlings, feed, equipment), inadequate infrastructure, weak organizational capacity among actors, low adoption of sustainable practices, and restricted market access for aquaculture products.
